summary.text: Human Mountain is the artificial human path secluded domain Chai clan creates by mimicking Human Sea.

claims.text: When Wu Shuai retrieves Xia clan’s incomplete Human Sea, Fang Yuan’s prior life memory already holds the later counterpart: Southern Border’s Chai clan gains key comprehension from Human Sea and starts creating a similar artificial secluded domain named Human Mountain. Wisdom path Gu Immortals of that time deduce that fusing Human Sea and Human Mountain could form an actual secluded domain of heaven and earth. Wu Shuai calls that fused Human Mountain and Sea too far away for the present need.

After obtaining Human Smoke Mountain, Fang Yuan keeps the mountain rather than spending it on the artificial earth vein. His human path intuition says that continuing Chai clan’s human path research results will let him condense the essence of Human Smoke Mountain and form an incomplete Human Mountain. By then Human Sea is complete, but Human Mountain has yet to form. He judges the combination of Human Mountain and Human Sea extremely powerful, notes he never saw that fusion in five hundred years of his previous life, and treats constructing Human Mountain as a long-term project far in the future.

In the five hundred years of Fang Yuan’s previous life, after Xia clan used Human Sea for revival and invaded Southern Border, Chai clan mimicked Human Sea and created its own Human Mountain secluded domain.
